title: Extreme Weather Forecasts Impact on U.S. Natural Gas Futures Prices: Market Efficiency and Risk Premia Implications
summary: Owned continuous NG cannot reconstruct NG1–NG2. Both identified maturities and point-in-time forecasts missing; park without proxy.
findings: Related published study describes longNG1/shortNG2 for five days after unusually cold forecasts.
mechanism: Compensation for extreme-weather demand and relative contract exposure is plausible; not verified profit.
build_on: Owned continuous NG cannot reconstruct NG1–NG2. Both identified maturities and point-in-time forecasts missing; park without proxy.
code_feasibility: Yes in principle with paired contracts, forecasts, full source and native costs; not now.
source_revision: SSRN abstract and2025 publisher/institutional metadata; full paper not read.
